messages:
alex: Quick checklist before we flip KV into staging for envelope encryption + rotation. Few things I'm worried about: managed identity scoping (user-assigned vs system), RBAC vs access policies, cross-tenant CI runners, diag settings for audit logs, and a safe plan for data-key rewrap. any gotchas?

maria: +1. Main gotcha: access policies still work but RBAC is the newer model for new vaults. If we go RBAC, make sure the principal has the crypto permissions (wrap/unwrap/get). Test role propagation delay — sometimes takes ~30s-2m.

kevin: For MSI, prefer user-assigned MI attached to the VM/VMSS or AKS nodepool so we can rotate infra without changing identities. NOTE: user-assigned MIs do NOT work across tenants. If our CI runners live in a different tenant, use an AAD app (service principal) and grant it RBAC on the vault (or use guest SP in the vault tenant).

sudha: Rotation approach: 1) create a new key version in KV or a new key name, 2) run a rewrap job that unwraps the encrypted data-key with the old key and wraps with the new key, 3) swap pointers in metadata. Important: idempotency, batching, and tracking state per item. Keep soft-delete + purge protection ON.

alex: any quick azure cli examples for wrap/unwrap for the rewrap job?

maria: snippet: 

```
# unwrap encrypted data key -> returns plaintext
az keyvault key unwrap --vault-name my-vault --name app-key --algorithm RSA-OAEP --value <encrypted-data-key>
# wrap plaintext data key -> returns encrypted blob
az keyvault key wrap --vault-name my-vault --name app-key --algorithm RSA-OAEP --value <plaintext-data-key>
```

kevin: Also: enable diagnostic settings -> send to Log Analytics + Storage account (for long term) + Event Hub (for SIEM). Enable categories: AuditEvent / KeyOperation / SecretGet. Set retention per compliance (e.g., 1y hot then archive). Add alert on KeyOperation failures and large numbers of unwraps.

maria: Vault configuration tips: enable soft-delete, purge protection, and RBAC if you want centralized role management. If you must use access policies (legacy), keep the principal lists tight. For tenant issues: cross-tenant SPs are fiddly — guest principals or service principals created in the vault tenant are the cleanest.

alex: perfect — I'll add these items to the staging runbook: RBAC checks, MI assignment, diag + retention, rewrap job with backoff, and tenant mapping notes. will ping before flip. :thumbsup:
